candidates.purpose: Yahoo market-data client with synchronous/asynchronous WebSocket streaming, screener/search and multi-symbol download patterns
candidates.maintenance: high/current; v1.7.0 released 2026-08-26 and same-day test/resilience fixes
candidates.docsTests: strong documentation; active tests and recent resilience fixes
candidates.securityNotes: No production adoption. Uses unofficial/public Yahoo endpoints; terms state Yahoo data is intended for personal use. WebSocket source is not an authoritative exchange feed. Treat disconnect/reconnect and message decoding as untrusted input.
candidates.lookAheadRisk: medium if intraday snapshots are later reused without event timestamps; require point-in-time timestamp retention and no backfill into historical signal states
candidates.dataCostRequirements: No package fee, but underlying Yahoo usage/terms and source reliability constrain production suitability
candidates.decisionReason: Useful heartbeat/re-subscription/reconnect patterns and AsyncWebSocket challenger, but source provenance/TOS and non-exchange authority prevent direct production dependency. Benchmark against current polling before any integration.

notes: The current production live-quote issue was addressed without adding yfinance as a dependency; only concurrency/fail-closed patterns were promoted.
